meta_description: Based in Duncansville, PA. Title, leasing and due diligence across the Appalachian, Gulf Coast, Permian and Michigan basins, and the landmen who do the work.
page_subtitle: Rickey and Shannon Matherne, Certified Professional Landmen in Duncansville, Pennsylvania.
intro: We work for operators, exploration companies, independent producers, mineral and royalty owners, and institutional investors. Projects range from curative work on a single tract to multi-county leasing programs, acquisition and divestiture (A&D) packages, and due diligence on whole portfolios.
approach:
We run title all the way to the end of the chain, not just to the first clean deed. Problems often sit several transfers back, in probate and heirship records filed in a county or index nobody expected.

When the record is unclear, we say so. We do not fill the gap with a guess. Each report states what we found, what it means and what the options are, and it is written so you can hand it straight to an attorney, a lender or a buyer's team.

Every project gets the same standard, whatever its size.

cta.headline: Talk it through with Rickey or Shannon.
cta.text: Have a project, or a letter about your land? Call or send a note. You'll hear back from Rickey or Shannon.
